name: Keyword Research Pro — legacy paid user configures a full analysis
description: A signed-in legacy paid user can configure Keyword Research Pro without being sent to the All Access upgrade screen.

planSteps.description: Sign in with the configured TestSprite test account credentials
Open the existing Default project from the Projects page
Open Keyword Research from the project navigation
Enter two different keywords in the keyword input
Verify Pro Analysis remains open without an upgrade card and shows the keyword limit changed to 10, Standard and BYOK billing choices, and an enabled Run research button
Verify the estimated total is visible and reflects a Full + backlinks analysis for the two entered keywords
